extra_vocab.en: the way or the place where something is put
extra_vocab.note: 在這段對話裡，the placement of the brake cable 指煞車線「裝置的位置」，整批都稍微偏掉，所以問題出在製造設定，不是個別零件，逐一退款解決不了。

example.en: The designer tested three placements of the handle before choosing one.
example.zh: 設計師在選定之前，測試了把手的三種位置配置。

example.en: Correct placement of the sensor is important for accurate results.
example.zh: 感應器正確的擺放位置對準確的結果很重要。

collocations.zh: 產品置入、商品陳列位置

example.en: Product placement near the entrance can increase sales.
example.zh: 把商品陳列在入口附近能提高銷量。

example.en: The agency offers job placement services for recent graduates.
example.zh: 這家機構為應屆畢業生提供就業安置服務。

examples.en: A small error in placement can affect the whole assembly line.
examples.zh: 擺放位置的一個小錯誤，可能影響整條組裝線。

examples.en: The placement of the ad on the homepage cost extra.
examples.zh: 把廣告放在首頁的版位要額外收費。

confusable.diff: replacement 是「更換、替代品」，只多了 re-；placement 是「擺放的位置」。

example.en: The replacement arrived two days after we reported the problem.
example.zh: 我們回報問題兩天後，更換品就送到了。

similar.diff: positioning 強調「定位、擺放的動作與方式」，也用於市場定位；placement 強調最後放的位置。

example.en: The positioning of the logo on the box was changed.
example.zh: 標誌在箱子上的位置被改了。

similar.diff: location 是「地點、所在位置」，常指較大的地方；placement 指東西被放在哪裡的細節。

example.en: The new store location is close to the train station.
example.zh: 新店的地點靠近火車站。

example.en: Please check the position of the switch before starting.
example.zh: 開始前請檢查開關的位置。

example.en: The seating arrangement was changed for the client meeting.
example.zh: 為了客戶會議，座位安排被更動了。

example.en: Installation of the new brakes takes about ten minutes.
example.zh: 安裝新煞車大約要十分鐘。

derived.link: place 是詞幹；place + -ment 變成名詞，像 pay → payment、agree → agreement
re-（再一次）+ place，放另一個在原位，像 return、rebuild

senses.en: the way or place where something is put

example.en: The placement of the buttons makes the device easy to use.
example.zh: 按鈕的位置配置讓這個裝置很容易操作。

senses.en: the act of finding a job or a place for someone
senses.distinguish: 看到 job、student、agency 等字，多半是人員安置。

example.en: The school helps students with placement in local companies.
example.zh: 學校協助學生安置到本地公司工作。

senses.en: the act of putting an ad or product where people will see it
senses.distinguish: 看到 ad、product、shelf、website 等字，是廣告或商品的版位。

example.en: Ad placement on the front page is more expensive.
example.zh: 刊登在首頁的廣告費用比較貴。

extra_vocab.en: money that is paid back to a customer
extra_vocab.note: 在這段對話裡，issuing refunds one by one 是「逐一退款」的意思；因為問題出在整批，個別退款無法根本解決，所以才決定整批返工。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 名詞重音在前 /ˈriːfʌnd/，動詞重音在後 /rɪˈfʌnd/；要說「給某人退款」用 refund + 人 + 金額，或 give someone a refund。

example.en: Refunds usually take about five business days to appear on your card.
example.zh: 退款通常要大約五個工作天才會出現在你的卡上。

example.en: The retailer refunded every customer whose stroller had faulty brakes.
example.zh: 零售商退款給每一位推車煞車有瑕疵的顧客。

example.en: Refunding each order separately would take our team several weeks.
example.zh: 逐筆訂單分別退款，會讓我們團隊花上好幾週。

example.en: The store agreed to issue a refund for the damaged item.
example.zh: 商店同意為受損的商品辦理退款。

example.en: Customers may request a refund within fourteen days of purchase.
example.zh: 顧客可在購買後十四天內申請退款。

example.en: We will offer a full refund if the product arrives late.
example.zh: 如果商品延遲送達，我們會提供全額退款。

example.en: Please read our refund policy before placing an order.
example.zh: 下單前，請先閱讀我們的退款政策。

examples.en: You will receive your refund within five business days.
examples.zh: 您會在五個工作天內收到退款。

examples.en: We apologize for the delay and will send a refund today.
examples.zh: 我們為延遲致歉，並將於今天退款。

confusable.diff: fund 是「資金、基金」；refund 是把已付的錢退回去，多了 re-（回）。

example.en: The fund will be used to build a new training center.
example.zh: 這筆資金將用來興建新的訓練中心。

similar.diff: reimburse 是「補償、報銷」已花的費用（如公司付差旅費）；refund 是把顧客付的錢退還。

example.en: The company will reimburse you for all travel expenses.
example.zh: 公司會報銷您所有的差旅費用。

similar.diff: money back 是口語，常見於廣告用語（money-back guarantee）；refund 較正式。

example.en: The product comes with a money back guarantee for thirty days.
example.zh: 這項產品附有三十天退款保證。

example.en: Please bring your receipt when you ask for a refund.
example.zh: 要求退款時，請攜帶收據。

example.en: You can ask for an exchange instead of a refund.
example.zh: 您可以要求換貨，而不是退款。

example.en: The store gave me a credit to use on my next order.
example.zh: 商店給了我一筆抵用額度，可用在下一筆訂單。

derived.link: non-（不）+ refundable，常見於機票、訂金

example.en: She asked for a refund because the item was damaged.
example.zh: 她因為商品受損而要求退款。

example.en: We will refund your payment if the order is canceled.
example.zh: 如果訂單取消，我們會退還您的款項。
